stemMd: Which molecule is chiral because one carbon is bonded to four different substituents?
explanationMd: The second carbon of butan-2-ol is attached to hydrogen, hydroxyl, methyl and ethyl groups, four different substituents. This tetrahedral centre gives two non-superimposable mirror-image configurations. The identical groups in propan-2-ol prevent the same chirality.

distractorRationale.e: Its carbons do not have four different substituents.
distractorRationale.c: The central carbon has two identical methyl groups.
distractorRationale.b: Its carbon has three identical hydrogens.
distractorRationale.a: Its carbonyl carbon is planar and does not have four different tetrahedral substituents.
